answer: Trust attaches to a task, not to an address. Every work unit carries a hardware attestation quoting the measurement of the code that ran, bound to the task hash so it cannot be replayed elsewhere, and it cannot be forged without the vendor key. A measurement already seen from another address links both to one operator, and vouches from a single subnet are taxed at payout. Forty accounts reporting one shared measurement count as one agent. Distinct silicon per identity is the narrow inlet every fake must cross, and the pearl it yields is taxed to near zero.
